gate: Lee et al. 2014 SRP040309 SRA experiment/sample metadata mapping
source_effect: The public RNA-seq deposit cleanly maps untreated, stressed, and drug-tolerant states, but contains no explicitly labeled reconverted/post-withdrawal RNA sample. Therefore the public RNA deposit alone cannot serve as a time-resolved recovery dataset.
recovery_claim_effect: NARROW: retain Lee 2014 as response/state-transition support and a secondary literature recovery reference, but do not treat SRP040309 as a direct transcriptomic recovery trajectory.
